items.title: EyePoint halves workforce and ends Phase III trial early after endpoint miss
items.summary: The biotech is now hoping that duravyu will have more success in DME, with pivotal readouts expected late next year.

items.title: Merck KGaA spends $1.3bn to buy siRNA specialist Silence Therapeutics
items.summary: Buying the UK-based biotech will add a siRNA drug candidate with high sales potential to Merck’s portfolio.

items.title: Ambrose Healthcare fortifies rare disease pipeline on AM-Pharma takeover
items.summary: Ambrose will now enter the race to debut a new medicine on the HPP market as the only approved therapy edges closer to key patent expiries.

items.title: Roche’s Enspryng nets a second indication on FDA eye disease approval
items.summary: Enspryng is the first drug suitable for at-home administration in TED, but analysts are lukewarm on its commercial potential.

items.title: MHRA could allow schools to hold reserves of nasal adrenaline spray
items.summary: Though schools already store autoinjectors like EpiPen, a nasal spray would offer another easy-to-use option.
